Metadata.title: Pawth | A Small Daily Journaling App
Metadata.description: A journaling app that helps you visualize your daily journey and commit to today's reflection.

Hero.label: About Pawth
Hero.title: Pawth
Hero.lead: A daily journal for leaving one small footprint each day
Hero.description: Record your day, then look back on your journey through the calendar and timeline.

Screens.label: App Screens
Screens.title: What You Can Do with Pawth
Screens.description: Record each day and look back on the days you've accumulated in different ways.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Each day you write an entry leaves a footprint on the calendar, making it easy to revisit what you recorded that day.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.description: Browse your past entries chronologically and scroll through the record you've built over time.

settings.title: Customize
settings.description: Choose the icon displayed on your calendar and change the visibility of your journal.
